text:
Ana Chen: Quick ops checklist for the Virtual Summit tomorrow. Need confirmations on registration page, Zoom settings, recording exports, and post-event lead routing. Reg page (Typeform): https://redwood.typeform.com/vsummit - please add utm_campaign=virtual_summit_may26
Marcus Li: I'm owner for reg page copy + UTM params. Will finalize hero and session_interest field by tonight. Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Vsum-copy
Tia Patel: Panelist logistics: do we want unique join links per speaker? If not, ensure cohost invites are in place. Also confirm we do NOT require Zoom auth for external speakers.
Oliver Grant: Rehearsal scheduled 10:30am PT tomorrow. Ask panelists to join 15m early for audio check. I'll run through spotlight and screen-share order.
Eve Johnson: Post-event nurture: three emails -> 1) Replay + TL;DR clips, 2) Technical deep dive whitepaper, 3) Product trial CTA with personalized note. I'll build HubSpot workflows and assign new registrants to SDR queue "event_inbound". What counts as MQL here?
Marcus Li: MQL = clicked demo CTA or filled follow-up interest form on replay page. Tag properties: event:vsummit and event_intent:high. Route to AE for follow-up within 48h.
ops-bot: System status: Zoom cloud recording -> GCS bucket gs://redwood-events/2026/vsummit (write-perm: marketing). HubSpot webhook endpoint /webhooks/hubspot/event returns 200. Auto-clip job scheduled after recording finishes.
Ana Chen: Please double-check Zoom settings below before kickoff:
```
- registration: required (we collect via Typeform)
- passcode: disabled
- cloud_recording: enabled (record active_speaker + gallery + shared_screen)
- auto_transcribe: enabled (SRT output)
- allow_multiple_hosts: true
- enable_language_interpretation: false
```
Co-hosts: Marcus Li, Oliver Grant. Enable spotlighting for panelists and allow remote control for demos.
Oliver Grant: Confirmed co-host invites sent. RTMP fallback set to rtmp://backup.redwood.ai/live. Encoder will standby.
Tia Patel: Speaker consent form sent to all presenters. Include checkbox: "I consent to recording and reuse of clips for marketing, product demos, and social media."
Eve Johnson: HubSpot mapping: map utm_campaign, utm_source, and Typeform field session_interest. Trigger workflow on Typeform submit OR tag event:vsummit_reg. Assign owner by region field. Will draft nurture emails now.
Marcus Li: After event, editing owners: marketing-editors handles full-length edits; product-marketing handles highlight clips (2-4). Use clip ownership doc to tag editors.
Ana Chen: Ops snippet for Zoom API if needed:
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.zoom.us/v2/meetings/MEETING_ID \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZOOM_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"settings": {"registration_type": 1, "auto_recording": "cloud", "host_video": true, "participant_video": true}}'
```
Eve Johnson: I'll monitor webhook payloads after the event (expect email, utm_campaign, form_id, and tags). Setting short attend/non-attend nurture branches.
Oliver Grant: Reminder to editors: raw files will land in gs://redwood-events/2026/vsummit/raw. Do not rename raw files to keep transcripts aligned.
Ana Chen: I'll ping this channel 30 minutes prior for final go/no-go. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Marcus Li: Copy.
Tia Patel: Consent forms all returned.
Eve Johnson: HubSpot flows drafted, will publish after final copy signoff.
ops-bot: Auto-clip job queued and awaiting recording completion.
